tasks.title: Runner Abstraction & Vitest Refactor (US2)
tasks.description:
Create the TestRunner interface, TestRunnerFactory skeleton, and refactor VitestRunner behind the new abstraction. This phase establishes the framework-agnostic pipeline without introducing any Dart code.

Covers spec tasks: T001-T011
Delivers: User Story 2 (Vitest regression safety)

Key deliverables:
1. TestRunner interface + types (TestFramework, TestRunOptions, TestRunOutput, NormalizedTestOutcome) in src/core/testing/TestRunner.ts
2. TestRunnerFactory skeleton with static create() method in src/core/testing/TestRunnerFactory.ts
3. Refactor VitestRunner to implement TestRunner interface, absorb Vitest JSON parsing (parseVitestJson, convertTestResults, normalizeStatus, calculateDuration) from ResultFormatter — src/core/testing/VitestRunner.ts
4. Update ResultFormatter.format() to accept NormalizedTestOutcome[] instead of unknown vitestJson, removing Vitest-specific parsing methods. Summary output must include framework identifier (e.g., 'PASS (flutter)', 'FAIL (dart)') — src/core/testing/ResultFormatter.ts
5. Expand TestConfigSchema framework field to z.enum(['vitest', 'dart', 'flutter']) and add pubspec.yaml/dart_test.yaml to configFingerprint defaults — src/core/testing/TestConfigLoader.ts
6. Update pre-signal-test-adapter to use TestRunnerFactory.create(config.framework) instead of direct VitestRunner instantiation — src/core/pre-signal-test-adapter.ts
7. Wire VitestRunner into TestRunnerFactory.create() for 'vitest' framework — src/core/testing/TestRunnerFactory.ts
8. Update barrel exports for all new/modified modules — src/core/testing/index.ts
9. Create VitestRunner interface compliance and regression tests. All mocks MUST implement TestRunner interface explicitly (per FR-019/Lesson 7) — test/unit/core/testing/VitestRunner.test.ts
10. Run full existing test suite (npm test) to verify zero Vitest regressions

Reference contracts: specs/015-dart-flutter-test-runner/contracts/test-runner-interface.md
Reference data model: specs/015-dart-flutter-test-runner/data-model.md

Checkpoint: Vitest works exactly as before through the new TestRunner abstraction. No Dart code yet.

success_criteria: TestRunner interface exported from src/core/testing/TestRunner.ts with framework, execute(), and buildCommand() members
TestRunnerFactory.create('vitest') returns a VitestRunner instance
VitestRunner implements TestRunner interface (class VitestRunner implements TestRunner)
ResultFormatter.format() accepts NormalizedTestOutcome[] — no Vitest-specific parsing methods remain in ResultFormatter
ResultFormatter summary output includes framework identifier (e.g., 'PASS (vitest)')
TestConfigSchema framework field accepts 'vitest', 'dart', 'flutter'
pre-signal-test-adapter uses TestRunnerFactory.create() instead of direct VitestRunner instantiation
Barrel exports include TestRunner, TestRunnerFactory, TestFramework, TestRunOptions, TestRunOutput, NormalizedTestOutcome
VitestRunner regression tests pass — all mocks implement TestRunner interface explicitly
Full existing test suite (npm test) passes with zero regressions
verification.test_strategy: Unit tests for VitestRunner interface compliance in test/unit/core/testing/VitestRunner.test.ts. Full regression via npm test.

tasks.title: DartRunner Implementation (US1 - MVP)
tasks.description:
Implement the DartRunner class — the core Dart/Flutter test execution engine. Agents can execute Dart/Flutter tests through the Orchestra run_tests tool and receive structured results identical in format to Vitest.

Covers spec tasks: T012-T018
Delivers: User Story 1 (Run Dart/Flutter Tests Through Orchestra Pipeline)

Key deliverables:
1. DartRunner class with buildCommand() generating dart test/flutter test CLI args and execute() with process spawning. Flutter projects apply --no-pub by default; pure Dart projects only when dartNoPub is explicitly set (per FR-005) — src/core/testing/DartRunner.ts
2. NDJSON parser (extractJsonEvents line filtering, eventsToOutcomes correlating testStart/testDone/error events) — src/core/testing/DartRunner.ts
3. Dart failure compression, expected/actual extraction from assertion errors, and stack trace compression (max 5 project-relevant frames) — src/core/testing/DartRunner.ts
4. Flutter engine log filtering in extractJsonEvents and file:// URL to path conversion with Windows drive letter normalization (FR-013) — src/core/testing/DartRunner.ts
5. Add dartNoPub (z.boolean().optional()) and dartExcludeTags (z.array(z.string()).optional()) fields to TestConfigSchema — src/core/testing/TestConfigLoader.ts
6. Wire DartRunner into TestRunnerFactory.create() for 'dart' and 'flutter' frameworks — src/core/testing/TestRunnerFactory.ts
7. Create DartRunner unit tests using fixtures from testing/tdd-test-harness/dart/fixtures/ (passing-tests.ndjson, failing-tests.ndjson, mixed-results.ndjson, empty-suite.ndjson, flutter-with-noise.ndjson, partial-timeout.ndjson). All mocks MUST implement TestRunner interface explicitly (per FR-019/Lesson 7) — test/unit/core/testing/DartRunner.test.ts

Test coverage must include: NDJSON parsing, failure compression, command construction, Flutter log filtering, partial timeout output, missing dart/flutter executable error, and empty test suite (zero events → pass status).

Checkpoint: run_tests scope=suite target=unit works for a Dart/Flutter project.

success_criteria: DartRunner class exists in src/core/testing/DartRunner.ts implementing TestRunner interface
DartRunner.buildCommand() generates correct CLI args for both dart test and flutter test
Flutter projects apply --no-pub by default in buildCommand()
Pure Dart projects only apply --no-pub when dartNoPub config is explicitly set
NDJSON parser correctly filters non-JSON lines (engine logs, progress) and parses valid test events
eventsToOutcomes correctly correlates testStart/testDone/error events into NormalizedTestOutcome[]
Failure compression extracts expected/actual values from Dart assertion error messages
Stack trace compression retains max 5 project-relevant frames, removing framework-internal frames
file:// URLs correctly converted to paths with uppercase drive letters on Windows (FR-013)
Empty test suite (zero events) returns pass status with zero counts, not error
Partial timeout output captures whatever results were emitted before timeout (FR-015)
Missing dart/flutter executable returns clear ToolError, not opaque spawn failure
TestRunnerFactory.create('dart') and create('flutter') return DartRunner instances
dartNoPub and dartExcludeTags fields accepted in TestConfigSchema
All DartRunner unit tests pass using NDJSON fixtures
verification.test_strategy: Unit tests in test/unit/core/testing/DartRunner.test.ts using NDJSON fixtures from testing/tdd-test-harness/dart/fixtures/. Covers parsing, command construction, failure compression, log filtering, edge cases.

tasks.title: Dart Related Resolver & Import Graph (US4)
tasks.description:
Implement the Dart-specific related file resolver so that scope=related discovers affected test files from changed source files using naming conventions, import graph analysis, and directory fallback.

Covers spec tasks: T019-T025
Delivers: User Story 4 (Find Related Dart Tests from Changed Source Files)

Key deliverables:
1. DartRelatedResolver with three-strategy mapper — src/core/testing/DartRelatedResolver.ts:
   - Strategy 1: Naming convention (lib/src/X.dart → test/**/X_test.dart)
   - Strategy 2: Import graph via DartImportGraph.resolveTransitiveDependents() for depth-3 transitive resolution (NOT direct grep)
   - Strategy 3: Same-directory fallback (run all tests in corresponding test directory)
2. DartImportGraph reverse dependency builder using Dart import statement parsing — src/core/testing/DartImportGraph.ts
3. mtime-based cache invalidation, depth-3 transitive walk limit with cycle detection, and .dart_tool/ exclusion — src/core/testing/DartImportGraph.ts
4. Windows-compatible mtime fingerprinting (no Unix find) and optional ripgrep acceleration with graceful fallback when ripgrep unavailable — src/core/testing/DartImportGraph.ts
5. Update ScopeResolver.resolveRelated() to check config.framework and dispatch to DartRelatedResolver for Dart/Flutter, and add *_test.dart to dirHasTestFiles() — src/core/testing/ScopeResolver.ts
6. DartRelatedResolver unit tests — test/unit/core/testing/DartRelatedResolver.test.ts (test skeleton exists with .todo() stubs)
7. DartImportGraph unit tests — test/unit/core/testing/DartImportGraph.test.ts (test skeleton exists with .todo() stubs)

All mocks MUST implement relevant interfaces explicitly (per FR-019/Lesson 7).

Checkpoint: run_tests scope=related finds all transitively-affected Dart tests up to depth 3.

success_criteria: DartRelatedResolver exists in src/core/testing/DartRelatedResolver.ts with three-strategy mapper
Strategy 1 (naming): lib/src/X.dart maps to test/**/X_test.dart
Strategy 2 (import graph): uses DartImportGraph.resolveTransitiveDependents() — NOT direct grep
Strategy 3 (directory fallback): runs all tests in corresponding test directory when no direct matches found
DartImportGraph builds reverse dependency map from Dart import statement parsing
Import graph cache invalidated when file modification times change (mtime fingerprint)
Transitive walk limited to depth 3 with cycle detection (no infinite recursion)
.dart_tool/ directories excluded from file discovery and import graph traversal (FR-016)
Windows-compatible mtime fingerprinting (no Unix find command)
Graceful fallback when ripgrep unavailable (disable import-graph strategy instead of failing)
ScopeResolver dispatches to DartRelatedResolver for Dart/Flutter frameworks
dirHasTestFiles() recognizes *_test.dart files
All unit tests pass for both DartRelatedResolver and DartImportGraph
verification.test_strategy: Unit tests in test/unit/core/testing/DartRelatedResolver.test.ts and test/unit/core/testing/DartImportGraph.test.ts. Test skeletons exist with .todo() stubs to be replaced with real assertions.

tasks.title: Pre-Signal Verification for Dart (US3)
tasks.description:
Update the pre-signal verification pipeline so that Dart project tasks are verified through the shared test pipeline using the DartRunner, not separate shell commands.

Covers spec tasks: T026-T028
Delivers: User Story 3 (Pre-Signal Verification for Dart Projects)

Key deliverables:
1. Update pre-signal executor Flutter fallback from --exclude-tags tdd-red to --exclude-tags red in both getDefaultCommands() and getExcludeTddRedCommand() — src/core/pre-signal-executor.ts
2. Create pre-signal adapter integration test verifying DartRunner dispatch and result normalization — test/integration/dart-pipeline.test.ts
3. Create end-to-end Dart pipeline integration test (config load → scope resolve → DartRunner execute → ResultFormatter format → verify expectations) — test/integration/dart-pipeline.test.ts (same file)

Checkpoint: Full Dart pipeline works from signal_completion through pre-signal to results.

success_criteria: pre-signal-executor.ts uses --exclude-tags red (not tdd-red) in getDefaultCommands() and getExcludeTddRedCommand()
Pre-signal adapter dispatches to DartRunner for Dart/Flutter projects through TestRunnerFactory
Results from DartRunner are correctly normalized and fed to the pre-signal evaluation pipeline
Integration test verifies DartRunner dispatch and result normalization end-to-end
Pipeline test covers: config load → scope resolve → DartRunner execute → ResultFormatter format → expectation evaluation
Dart project without .agent-test-config.json falls back to legacy shell commands (not crash)
verification.test_strategy: Integration tests in test/integration/dart-pipeline.test.ts covering adapter dispatch and end-to-end pipeline flow.

tasks.title: TDD Red-Phase Workflow for Dart (US5)
tasks.description:
Verify and fix TDD red-phase workflow compatibility for Dart projects. Tests in test/red/ must be excluded from standard runs, evaluated with inverted expectations, and promotable to target tiers.

Covers spec tasks: T029-T031
Delivers: User Story 5 (TDD Red-Phase Workflow for Dart Projects)

Key deliverables:
1. Verify tdd-cleanup.ts cleanupDartMarkers() handles directory-based _test.dart layout — codebase already supports _test.dart glob in test/red/**/ (confirmed by analysis). Fix if issues found.
2. Verify tdd-scan-on-signal.ts isTestFile() identifies _test.dart and .test.dart patterns correctly (confirmed by analysis). Fix if issues found.
3. Verify and fix promoteTests tool for _test.dart file naming convention and red-phase annotation cleanup.

Note: These are primarily verification tasks — the existing codebase likely already supports _test.dart patterns. The task is to confirm and fix any gaps.

Checkpoint: TDD red-phase workflow works for Dart: red tier tests excluded from standard runs, inverted expectations work, promotion cleans up markers.

success_criteria: cleanupDartMarkers() in tdd-cleanup.ts correctly handles _test.dart files in test/red/**/ directories
isTestFile() in tdd-scan-on-signal.ts correctly identifies both _test.dart and .test.dart patterns
promoteTests tool correctly handles _test.dart file naming when promoting from test/red/{tier}/ to test/{tier}/
Red-phase annotation cleanup works for Dart test files (// @orchestra-task: N removed)
Standard test tier runs exclude test/red/ directory for Dart projects
Red tier runs with inverted expectations correctly evaluate Dart test failures as success
verification.test_strategy: Verification of existing code paths with targeted fixes. Manual review of tdd-cleanup.ts, tdd-scan-on-signal.ts, and promoteTests handler. Run existing TDD-related tests to confirm no regressions.

tasks.title: Auto Framework Detection (US6)
tasks.description:
Implement automatic framework detection so projects without .agent-test-config.json are correctly identified as Dart, Flutter, or Vitest based on workspace file markers.

Covers spec tasks: T032-T034
Delivers: User Story 6 (Automatic Framework Detection)

Key deliverables:
1. Implement TestRunnerFactory.detect() checking pubspec.yaml content (Flutter deps → 'flutter', Dart only → 'dart') and vitest.config.* (→ 'vitest') — src/core/testing/TestRunnerFactory.ts
2. Add dual-framework conflict detection — error with ToolErrorCode.INVALID_INPUT when both pubspec.yaml and vitest.config.* are present — src/core/testing/TestRunnerFactory.ts
3. Handle malformed/unreadable manifest: return clear error directing user to create explicit .agent-test-config.json (not opaque parse failure)
4. Create TestRunnerFactory detection unit tests (Dart detection, Flutter detection, Vitest detection, dual-marker error, malformed manifest fallback). All mocks MUST implement TestRunner interface explicitly (per FR-019/Lesson 7) — test/unit/core/testing/TestRunnerFactory.test.ts

Checkpoint: Auto-detection works for all three frameworks. Dual-marker workspaces fail with clear error.

success_criteria: TestRunnerFactory.detect() exists and correctly identifies Dart, Flutter, and Vitest projects
pubspec.yaml with Flutter dependencies detected as 'flutter' framework
pubspec.yaml without Flutter dependencies detected as 'dart' framework
vitest.config.* files detected as 'vitest' framework
Dual-marker workspace (both pubspec.yaml and vitest.config.*) returns ToolErrorCode.INVALID_INPUT error
Malformed/unreadable manifest returns clear error directing to explicit .agent-test-config.json
All TestRunnerFactory detection unit tests pass
verification.test_strategy: Unit tests in test/unit/core/testing/TestRunnerFactory.test.ts covering all detection scenarios, conflict detection, and error handling.
